summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, disclosing its acquisition of PRN, an in-store retail media company with exclusive multi-year partnerships across major North American retailers. The transaction is valued at up to $12 million and is expected to be accretive from closing. Perion aims to expand its retail media and digital out-of-home reach, leveraging PRN's footprint across 750+ warehouse club locations, 4,500+ big-box stores, and 2,200+ healthcare retail locations. No financial advisors, premium, or structural details were disclosed. Watch for integration progress and accretion realization.
